prompt: Choose the best word or sentence for blank [133].
promptZh: 請選出最適合填入第 133 題空格的字詞或句子。

options.text: Please send the two sign-offs as separate messages.
options.zh: 請分別發送兩封核准訊息。
options.whyZh: 依各自時程回覆，印刷廠能在收到大廳版核准後先放行，而員工版仍保留待確認。

options.text: Please wait and send both approvals in a single message.
options.zh: 請等兩張都核准後，再併在同一封訊息寄出。
options.whyZh: 這會迫使大廳版等明天，和後文說不用等員工版審核相反。

options.text: Please give both proofs the file name of the first map.
options.zh: 請把兩張校樣都改成第一張地圖的檔名。
options.whyZh: 檔名相同會讓兩張難以區分；後段要求寫出檔名以明確指出核准對象。

options.text: Please ask the printer to release both maps once Reception replies.
options.zh: 請在接待櫃台回覆後請印刷廠放行兩張圖。
options.whyZh: 今天只能放行大廳版；後文要求員工版仍待確認。

explanationZh: 依各自時程回覆，印刷廠能在收到大廳版核准後先放行，而員工版仍保留待確認。
evidence: Reception can sign off on the lobby proof today. Building Services will review the staff proof tomorrow. / This lets the printer release the lobby map without waiting for the staff review, while keeping the second file on hold.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Reception can sign off on the lobby proof today. Building Services will review the staff proof tomorrow.
This lets the printer release the lobby map without waiting for the staff review, while keeping the second file on hold.

vocabulary.note: 用於同意某份文件或版面可以進下一步。
